mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering a risk-off response that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in housing starts (HOUST) indicate deteriorating economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 3 months AND HOUST falls > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and HOUST falls > 5% over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3.0% annually signals economic overheating, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 5% and RSAFS falls > 3% in 3 months
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline by more than 5% and 3% respectively over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.0% signals reduced liquidity, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary tightening cycle regime, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.
